atoms.b:
English around the world

There is no language in the world that is understood and spoken by as many people as ((++English German)).
atoms.sound: ssml: English around the world.<break time='1000ms'/> There is no language in the world that is understood and spoken by as many people as English.

atoms.b: English originated in ((++Great_Britain Russia)). Due to the expansion of the British Empire and its ((++colonialism democracy)) in the 18th and 19th centuries, it spread all over the world.
atoms.sound: ssml: English originated in Great Britain. Due to the expansion of the British Empire and its colonialism in the 18th and 19th centuries, it spread all over the world.

atoms.b: Most former British colonies are now ((++independent tropical)) but have retained English as an ((++official incomprehensible)) language.

atoms.b: Due to ((++globalization renaissance)), English has become widespread around the world. It is now widely used as the official language in international communication, ((++economy dance)), medicine, and technology.
atoms.sound: ssml: Due to globalization, English has become widespread around the world. It is now widely used as the official language in international communication, economy, medicine, and technology.

atoms.b: Today, English is spoken by ((++1.5_billion 300)) people and is an official language in 67 ((++countries villages)). This makes it the most important ((++world_language voice)) at the moment.
atoms.sound: ssml: Today, English is spoken by 1.5 billion people and is an official language in 67 countries. This makes it the most important world language at the moment.

atoms.a: In how many countries is English considered an official language?
What has made the English language so widespread in our world? Several answers are possible.
